mechanism: GABA-A receptor agonistic synergism leading to enhanced central nervous system depression and excessive daytime sedation.
citation: PubMed: Synergistic CNS Depressant Effects of Withania somnifera with Benzodiazepines
recommended_action: Avoid concurrent daytime dosing. Recommend taking Ashwagandha in morning and Clonazepam at bedtime with >= 5 hour separation, or step-down dose.

mechanism: Withania stimulates endogenous thyroid hormone synthesis (T3 and T4), potentially causing subclinical hyperthyroidism or thyrotoxicosis when co-administered with Levothyroxine.
citation: AYUSH Monograph Vol IV; J Altern Complement Med 2018
recommended_action: Relative caution for daytime sedation and thyroid shift. Check serum TSH/Free T4 at 4 weeks.

mechanism: Ferric ions in Mandura form insoluble ferric-thyroxine chelates in the acidic gastric lumen, reducing oral bioavailability of Levothyroxine by 40-60%.
recommended_action: Separate administration by at least 4 hours. Take Levothyroxine on empty stomach in morning and Mandura after main meals.

mechanism: Proton pump inhibitors elevate gastric pH, which reduces the solubility and gastrointestinal reduction of Fe3+ in Mandura Bhasma, thereby diminishing therapeutic iron bioavailability.
recommended_action: Co-administer Mandura Bhasma with an acidic adjuvant (Anupana) such as Amalaki juice (rich in Ascorbic Acid) to maintain iron solubility.

mechanism: Glycyrrhizin inhibits 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2, resulting in cortisol-induced mineralocorticoid receptor hyperactivation, sodium retention, hypokalemia, and elevated blood pressure, directly antagonizing the antihypertensive efficacy of Losartan.
recommended_action: Strictly contraindicated in unmanaged hypertension or require deglycyrrhizinated licorice (DGL).

mechanism: Glabridin exhibits weak CYP2C9 inhibition, which can reduce S-warfarin clearance and elevate INR, increasing hemorrhagic risk.
recommended_action: Close INR surveillance at baseline and 10 days post-initiation.

mechanism: Additive natriuretic and potassium-sparing tendencies may lead to transient hypotension and hyperkalemia if baseline renal function is impaired.
recommended_action: Monitor serum electrolytes and blood pressure at 2 weeks.

mechanism: Berberine and related alkaloids in Tinospora cordifolia enhance insulin sensitivity and AMPK phosphorylation, producing additive blood-glucose lowering with Metformin.
recommended_action: Educate patient on hypoglycemia warning signs; blood glucose self-monitoring recommended.
